stage_label: Stage 1: Enrolled Cohort in Administrative Registry

stage_label: Stage 2: Linked to >=1 Associated Location (Direct or Billing Group)
plain_english_note: 26 (0.4%) had a directly linked location; 5,617 (95.3%) were linked only through billing organizations.

stage_label: Stage 3: Linked to a Single Pinpoint Practice ZIP5 (1 ZIP5 in 1 State)
plain_english_note: Only 592 (10.0%) mapped to a single pinpoint ZIP5, whereas 4,033 (68.4%) fanned out across large multi-site or multi-state billing organizations (mean 30.0, median 14 unique ZIP5s).
461 (7.8% of cohort; 77.9% of pinpoint sites) had a corroborated pinpoint ZIP5, and 2,359 (40.0%) had a practice ZIP5 corroborated across all supplied reference sources.
